cuFileHandleRegister.doc: cuFileHandleRegister is required, and performs extra checking that is memoized to provide increased performance on later cuFile operations. # Return value CU_FILE_SUCCESS on successful completion. fh will be updated for use in `cuFileRead`, `cuFileWrite`, `cuFileHandleDeregister` # Return value CU_FILE_DRIVER_NOT_INITIALIZED on failure to load driver # Return value CU_FILE_IO_NOT_SUPPORTED - if filesystem is not supported # Return value CU_FILE_INVALID_VALUE if null or bad api arguments # Return value CU_FILE_INVALID_FILE_OPEN_FLAG if file is opened with unsupported modes like no O_DIRECT # Return value CU_FILE_INVALID_FILE_TYPE if filepath is not valid or is not a regular file # Return value CU_FILE_HANDLE_ALREADY_REGISTERED if file handle/descriptor is already registered Description cuFileHandleRegister registers the open file descriptor for use with cuFile IO operations. This API will ensure that the file's descriptor is checked for GPUDirect Storage support and returns a valid file handle on CU_FILE_SUCCESS. Note: the file needs to be opened in O_DIRECT mode to support GPUDirect Storage. See also: cuFileRead See also: cuFileWrite See also: cuFileHandleDeregister

cuFileRead.doc:
read data from a registered file handle to a specified device or host memory





# Return value

# Return value

-1 on error, in which case errno is set to indicate filesystem errors.

# Return value

all other errors will return a negative integer value of `CUfileOpError` enum value.



Note: If the bufPtr is not registered with `cuFileBufRegister`, the data will be buffered through preallocated pinned buffers if needed.

Note: This is useful for applications that need to perform IO to unaligned file offsets and/or size. This is also recommended for cases where the BAR1 memory size is smaller than the size of the allocated memory.
